_note: v2 hooks for the presbytère (B41). Cognates Like/plain; sacred items reverent; no God the Father figure.

fr_noel_noun.hook: Reverent: a choir sings "Noel" ("noh-EL") by candlelight for CHRISTMAS, a star shining over the crib.

fr_paques_noun.hook: Reverent: linked to "Paschal", said PAHK: families share painted eggs and spring flowers at EASTER.

fr_toussaint_noun.hook: Reverent: candles for ALL SAINTS' DAY ("too-SAN") glow on the church steps.

fr_careme_noun.hook: Reverent: during LENT ("kah-REHM") Rem parks his car and walks to church each Friday.

fr_epiphanie_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Epiphany", said ay-pih-fah-NEE: three paper crowns and a cake for EPIPHANY, the kings' feast.
fr_epiphanie_noun.why: eglise4: age-appropriate rule 101 — no pee syllable

fr_avent_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Advent", said ah-VAHN: a wreath with four candles marks ADVENT in the church.

fr_pentecote_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Pentecost", said pahnt-KOHT: red banners hang in church for PENTECOST Sunday.

fr_rameaux_noun.hook: Reverent: on PALM SUNDAY ("rah-MOH") a ram watches villagers carry palm branches to church.

fr_nativite_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Nativity", said nah-tee-vee-TAY: a NATIVITY scene with a manger, shepherds and sheep.

fr_octave_noun.hook: Reverent: like "octave", said ok-TAHV: a calendar marks the eight-day OCTAVE of Easter.

fr_neuvaine_noun.hook: Reverent: like "novena", said nuh-VEHN: nine candles lit one per day for a NOVENA.

fr_jeuner_verb.hook: Reverent: a pilgrim on a long journey ("zheuh-NAY") pauses to FAST and pray quietly, his bread left untouched in the bag beside him.

fr_commemorer_verb.hook: Like "commemorate", said koh-may-moh-RAY: a plaque COMMEMORATES a town hero.

fr_dieu_noun.hook: Reverent: at sunrise, morning dew ("DYUH") sparkles on the grass outside a quiet chapel as golden rays stream from the sky; the word GOD is carved over the door (no figure is shown).

fr_grace_noun.hook: Reverent: like "grace", said GRAHS: a family bows their heads to say GRACE before supper.

fr_ame_noun.hook: A friendly ghost, a SOUL, takes AIM ("AHM") with a toy bow and suction-cup arrow.

fr_diable_noun.hook: Linked to "diabolical", said DYAHBL: a storybook DEVIL with little horns sulks on a catechism poster.

fr_ange_noun.hook: Reverent: linked to "angel", said AHNZH: a stained-glass ANGEL glows softly in a chapel window.

fr_croix_noun.hook: Reverent: a simple wooden CROSS stands on the altar of a quiet chapel.

fr_paradis_noun.hook: Linked to "paradise", said pah-rah-DEE: a garden PARADISE of fruit trees and singing birds.

fr_foi_noun.hook: Reverent: linked to "faith", said FWAH: a girl holds a small lamp steadily, a sign of FAITH.

fr_priere_noun.hook: Reverent: a child kneels by her bed for her evening PRAYER, hands folded.

fr_esperance_noun.hook: A little girl named ESPERANZA ("ess-pay-RONCE") lights a candle in the window: HOPE.

fr_sauveur_noun.hook: Reverent: like "savior", said soh-VUHR: the word SAVIOR glows in gold letters in an old hymnbook.

fr_catechisme_noun.hook: Reverent: like "catechism", said kah-tay-SHEEZM: children with open books in a CATECHISM class.

fr_tentation_noun.hook: Like English 'temptation', said tahn-tah-SYOHN: the TEMPTATION of a warm TENT and cocoa is too much for the shivering skier.

fr_demon_noun.hook: Like English 'demon', said day-MOHN: a little red beetle in the meadow is nicknamed the speed DEMON, zooming round daisies with a tiny racing scarf.

fr_psalmodier_verb.hook: Reverent: linked to "psalm", said psahl-moh-DYAY: pilgrims CHANT psalms walking the path.

fr_heresie_noun.hook: Reverent: like "heresy", said ay-ray-ZEE: an old council scroll condemns a HERESY.

fr_doctrine_noun.hook: Reverent: like "doctrine", said dok-TREEN: a book of DOCTRINE open in a catechism class.

fr_providence_noun.hook: Reverent: like "providence", said proh-vee-DAHNS: PROVIDENCE shown as a safe harbor after a storm.

fr_trinite_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Trinity", said tree-nee-TAY: a stained-glass shamrock symbolizes the TRINITY.

fr_incarnation_noun.hook: Reverent: like "Incarnation", said an-kahr-nah-SYOHN: a nativity window recalls the INCARNATION.

fr_oraison_noun.hook: Reverent: linked to "orison", said oh-reh-ZOHN: a quiet PRAYER whispered by candlelight.

fr_redemption_noun.hook: Reverent: like "redemption", said ray-dahnp-SYOHN: a hymn book open at a song of REDEMPTION.

fr_catechese_noun.hook: Reverent: like "catechesis", said kah-tay-SHEHZ: children sit in a circle for CATECHESIS lessons.

fr_messie_noun.hook: Reverent: like "messiah", said may-SEE: carol singers sing of the MESSIAH by candlelight.

fr_redempteur_noun.hook: Reverent: like "redeemer", said ray-dahnp-TUHR: a statue titled THE REDEEMER on a hilltop, arms open.

fr_resurrection_noun.hook: Reverent: like "resurrection", said ray-zew-rehk-SYOHN: an Easter sunrise over an empty garden tomb marks the RESURRECTION.
